text:
olivia: quick thread on the benchmark narrative for the launch assets. goal: make latency vs cost obvious for both devs and infra buyers. proposing three deliverables: an interactive token-latency heatmap (or a set of pre-rendered states), a compact scatter comparing $/M tokens vs 95th-pct latency, and a short 'pick-the-right-model' decision flow for common app slices. thoughts? :thinking_face:

sasha: yes to all. heatmap is the differentiator. show seq buckets (0-64, 65-256, 257-1024) so viewers see how latency and cost change with prompt size. :+1:

noah: i can generate the heatmap. i need data columns: model, quant, seq_bucket, tokens_per_s, median_latency_ms, cost_per_million_tokens. pulling from bench-run-2026-03 now. bench-bot linked a recent run: <https://bench.internal/runs/3419876500|bench-run-3419876500>.

emily: messaging note  avoid absolute percentage claims in headline. propose: "Cut inference cost without sacrificing responsiveness." subhead: "How to pick models & configs that meet your latency SLO and unit-econ target." keep it product-focused (how we help you choose), not just raw numbers.

oliver: for the webinar/demo: show the interactive heatmap live then run two mini-cases: an SMB chat app (short sequences) and a docs summarizer (long sequences). if an interactive is too heavy, pre-render three filter states: short/medium/long.

olivia: timeline: marketing needs final art + 1-pager by next Tue. noah  can you deliver initial heatmap PNG + CSV by EOD Fri? sasha  decision-flow copy Fri too? emily  i'll run the headline by legal. oliver  scope interactive feasibility with eng-platform by Mon.

noah: yes. i'll drop a CSV and a vega-lite spec mock. sample csv header:

model,quant,seq_bucket,tokens_per_s,median_latency_ms,cost_per_million_tokens
gptx-8k,int8,0-64,12000,45,12.3
gptx-8k,int8,65-256,8000,72,12.3
...

vega-lite mock (prototype):
{ "mark": "rect", "encoding": { "x": {"field": "seq_bucket","type":"ordinal"}, "y": {"field": "model","type":"ordinal"}, "color": {"field":"tokens_per_s","type":"quantitative","scale":{"scheme":"viridis"}}, "tooltip": [{"field":"median_latency_ms"},{"field":"cost_per_million_tokens"}] } }

sasha: the vega-lite will work for prototyping. for the blog hero render a simplified static PNG with three highlighted hotspots and a small legend mapping to workloads (chat, search, summarization).

emily: for copy we need three formats: short social, OG text, 1-paragraph blog intro. social draft: "Faster responses, lower unit cost  see how model choice and config change your latency & spend." will iterate when numbers are locked. :memo:

olivia: next steps recap:
- noah: heatmap PNG + CSV by Fri EOD
- sasha: decision-flow copy + hero art notes by Fri
- emily: headline + social drafts by Mon
- oliver: interactive feasibility + eng contact by Mon
- olivia: collate assets and schedule 30m sync Mon afternoon

bench-bot: run 3419876500 completed, artifacts uploaded: <https://bench.internal/runs/3419876500/artifacts> :robot_face:

sasha: small ask  include a short explainer about caching/prefix benefits in the blog. that explains big latency deltas for short sequences.

noah: will add a second CSV sheet with cache_on vs cache_off diffs so the heatmap can optionally call that out.

emily: agree. conservative hero claim + clear methodology callout = easier legal review.

olivia: thanks all  i'll post the invite when artifacts are in. :tada:
